_comment: Hashes of the artifacts a reported run must not silently change.
EVERY pin needs a `path`. The pin check resolves that path, requires it to be the
expected one, reads the file and hashes THOSE bytes -- not merely what was just
rendered. An earlier version compared only the fresh render and ignored the path, so
a missing or substituted artifact still reported a match.
A pin whose sha256 is null is NOT asserted.
system_prompt and tool_config are produced by instrument.py from the frozen codebook.
instrument.py never updates a pin as a side effect: --update-pins is explicit, so a
renderer change cannot redefine its own approved baseline and certify itself.
preflight.py loads these artifacts and assembles every probe with build_request(),
so a CERTIFIED preflight certifies this configuration. What is still owed is one
credentialed live run: the offline checks pass, but nothing is known about caching
or forced tool use until an artifact in tools/runs/ says so.
Paths are relative to tools/. Both roots were in use once, so preflight reported
'file does not exist' for artifacts it had just loaded.
Update a pin only deliberately, in the same commit as the change.
